topics.title: Gate relay-signed workflow messages on attributed author

entries.title: Gate relay-signed workflow messages on attributed author
entries.rationale: Accepted as an authorization correctness and hardening change. Preserve fail-closed relay-self discovery, exact workflow marker/owner tag validation, local signature verification, and the existing owner/sibling/allowlist policy.
security_reasons: relay-signed workflow messages must not gain authority from p-tag order
NIP-11 relay self identity is used as the trust anchor
attributed owner must pass the same inbound author policy as direct events
malformed, forged, duplicate, or unsigned attribution must fail closed
new /info network fetch changes startup egress

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated workflow attribution threat review, relay-self fetch/timeout tests, forgery and duplicate-tag tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and ACP/relay gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, relay sink tags, NIP-11 fetch, attribution gate, signature/shape tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
